boundaries.forward: Pretokenized device-resident tensors to raw logits, synchronized before/after; excludes transfers/tokenization/score conversion
boundaries.loading: Populated local checkpoint to device; no download/hash verification
boundaries.memory: PyTorch max_memory_allocated/reserved after reset following warm-up; covers resident weights plus the post-warm-up input, forward and score-conversion allocations. Not total device, driver/context or host memory.
boundaries.p95: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(0.95 * n) - 1]; median is the conventional median.
boundaries.rate: Derived forward-only rate = number of samples / sum of their synchronized forward durations. Not a measured wall-clock, sustained or end-to-end throughput; not 1 / median latency.

warmup.schedule: first three planned IDs in order

scope: Offline regeneration of single-pass pilot resource observations; no model run. Development feasibility only, not a final or controlled speed/memory benchmark.

workload.treatment_order: not established by measurement manifests; consult native execution records
